title: Submit KYC documents and see pending status
description: This test verifies that a verified user can submit KYC documents and then view the application in pending status.

steps.description: Navigate to /kyc
Fill identity document details into the KYC form
Fill address document details into the KYC form
Fill tax information into the KYC form
Submit the KYC application
Verify the KYC application is submitted
Verify the application status is pending

title: Browse active opportunities with category and trending filters
description: This test verifies that a user can discover active projects through the opportunities listing with filtering and sorting, and the list updates to show matching opportunities.

steps.description: Navigate to /opportunities
Select the AI category filter
Select the trending sort option
Set the results limit to 20
Verify matching opportunities are listed
Verify the listed opportunities reflect the selected filter criteria

title: View opportunity details and founder information
description: This test verifies that a user can open an opportunity and see the full project details, founder information, AI match score, and funding progress.

steps.description: Navigate to /opportunities
Click an opportunity from the list
Verify the opportunity detail view is displayed
Verify the project details, founder information, AI match score, and funding progress are shown

title: Save an opportunity from discovery
description: This test verifies that a user can bookmark an opportunity and see it reflected as saved in the discovery experience.

steps.description: Navigate to /discover
Click an opportunity from the results
Save the opportunity
Verify the opportunity is marked as saved
Verify the saved state is visible in the discovery experience

title: View notification inbox and mark items as read
description: This verifies that a signed-in user can open their notifications, see recent items, and mark selected notifications as read with the updated state reflected.

steps.description: Navigate to the notifications page
Wait for the notifications list to load
Select one or more unread notifications
Mark the selected notifications as read
Verify the notifications are listed
Verify the selected notifications are shown as read

title: View approved KYC status in profile
description: This test verifies that after KYC approval the user can see the approved compliance status in their profile.

steps.description: Navigate to /kyc
Submit a valid KYC application
Wait for the approved status to be visible in the application flow
Navigate to the profile page
Verify the profile shows KYC approved status
Verify the compliance status is reflected in the user profile

title: View and update personal profile settings
description: This verifies that a user can open their profile settings, edit personal details and preferences, and see the saved profile reflected afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to the settings page
Fill updated profile information into the editable fields
Fill updated preferences into the preferences fields
Save the changes
Verify the updated profile information is shown
Verify the updated preferences are shown

title: Send a direct message to another user
description: This test verifies that a user can send a direct message and see it appear in the active conversation.

steps.description: Navigate to /messages
Open an existing conversation
Fill a message into the composer
Send the message
Verify the message appears in the conversation
Verify the conversation updates with the new message

title: Start a conversation from a project and view message history
description: This test verifies that a user can start a direct conversation from an opportunity context and then see the conversation history in the messaging interface.

steps.description: Navigate to /opportunities
Open an opportunity detail view
Start a message conversation from the opportunity
Navigate to /messages
Verify the conversation appears in the message list
Verify the message history is displayed

title: View investor rankings on the leaderboard
description: This verifies that users can open the leaderboard and see investor rankings with performance metrics for the selected timeframe.

steps.description: Navigate to the leaderboard page
Select the investor ranking view
Select the monthly timeframe
Wait for the rankings to load
Verify investor rankings are listed
Verify performance metrics are displayed

title: Edit a recently sent message
description: This test verifies that a user can edit a message within the allowed time window and see the updated content reflected in the conversation.

steps.description: Navigate to /messages
Open a conversation containing a recent message
Edit the recent message
Save the edited message
Verify the updated message content is shown
Verify the conversation reflects the edited message

title: View project rankings on the leaderboard
description: This verifies that users can switch to project rankings and see the top projects with their associated stats.

steps.description: Navigate to the leaderboard page
Select the project ranking view
Select the all-time timeframe
Wait for the rankings to load
Verify project rankings are listed
Verify project stats are displayed

title: Handle invalid discovery filters
description: This test verifies that selecting an unsupported category filter does not return a normal opportunity list and the user is shown an invalid filter state.

steps.description: Navigate to /discover
Select an unsupported category filter
Apply the filter
Verify the discovery results are not shown as a normal opportunity list
Verify an invalid filter state is shown

title: View another user's public profile without private details
description: This verifies that a visitor can open a public profile page and see only publicly available information.

steps.description: Navigate to a public profile page
Wait for the profile to load
Verify the public profile information is shown
Verify private account details are not shown

title: Reject malformed profile information
description: This verifies that invalid profile input is blocked and the user is shown validation feedback instead of saving bad data.

steps.description: Navigate to the settings page
Fill malformed profile information into the relevant field
Save the changes
Verify a validation error is shown
Verify the profile changes are not saved

title: Reject unsupported KYC document types
description: This test verifies that the KYC form blocks unsupported file types and shows an error state instead of accepting the application.

steps.description: Navigate to /kyc
Fill the KYC form with unsupported document file types
Submit the KYC application
Verify the KYC submission is rejected
Verify an unsupported file type error state is shown

title: Handle an invalid notification selection gracefully
description: This verifies that the user sees a validation error when attempting to mark an invalid notification identifier as read and no successful read update is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to the notifications page
Wait for the notifications list to load
Attempt to mark an invalid notification selection as read
Verify a validation error is shown
Verify no read update is applied

title: Prevent editing an expired message
description: This test verifies that a user cannot edit a message after the allowed edit window has expired and is shown an expired-window state.

steps.description: Navigate to /messages
Open a conversation containing an older message
Attempt to edit the older message
Verify the message cannot be edited
Verify an edit window expired state is shown

title: Reject an unsupported leaderboard type
description: This verifies that an invalid leaderboard type is rejected and the user sees an error state instead of rankings.

steps.description: Navigate to the leaderboard page
Select an unsupported leaderboard type
Wait for the leaderboard to update
Verify an error state is shown
Verify no rankings are displayed
